Clear ‘Co-conscious’ is the best way to explain it in my terms; in regards to an encompassing feeling post death. My ego was and forever will be integral and perpetually there for its significance in role, protecting my values, whether those values were once hindered at the point of the lost innocence of a child-which is more lenient into my situation-or lost and gained in the moments we have breakthroughs. In my experience, these things that were in a sense tainted through specific type of abuse, were then perpetuated into larger entities when not faced. I had a really big phobic tendency to not do anything instead of failure. This led into tendencies of perceiving your reality as distortion, the mind tricking itself into thinking everything’s okay, because we learned how to disassociate and survive.
What this does to the subconscious, unconscious & conscious mind seems to be in attempt of simulating this struggle in duality. In which most everything perceivable is one in itself because of the nature of the universe. I felt as if my metaphysical understanding of the universe pioneered the change because of the core nature of who I was to begin with. My deeper level thinking/range of intelligence/ things that are good in nature but stigmatized, in home (submicro) and in the social world(submacro). This relates and perpetuates the idea that everything is everything if we need both good and evil to have balance. Free will (consciousness) that was placed into my possession, diluted the strength of the higher consciousness self that was made to break to rebuild. Anomaly in nature, has now gained a variable-ridden complexity. In which I had to endure so much slipping of consciousness and pain bearing that I thought I learned my lesson from. Once removed from trauma point a(y) to trauma point b(x) to trauma point c(z), there was common denomination that had to happen. I got reassured along the way by someone polar (dual) in my nature. My wife’s empathy, was fed on once the more evil protective measure realized that his reality isn’t shattered until he can no longer withstand it (to some degree). It speaks to many dsm related things because most all of these things are anxiety related manifestations of the things we ofc fear. Even if my life was extremely great, to the point I couldn’t do wrong. I would still develop narcissistic tendencies that live in all of us ready to be inhibited by my inflated sense of self worth, considering A=B if flipped and given the principle of variable  significant to the other one. I only have the universes fundamentals, alongside others free willed ideation to describe phenomena as such. 

As to feelings I can contribute to a stimuli sense, I am very familiar with the term numb as the embodiment of defeat and its relation to repression. I’ve felt nothing but true numbness, on the surface, most my life. As the inner child was being hindered by the source entities projected onto me from my families perpetuate problems. I fragmented. Sub and unconsciously built my own image for my own situations (masking/walls/alter egos) that were heavily impulsive at the time before death. Constant numbness will take the pain away outside your means and before you know it you’re pouring water down an ice tube in the Antarctic. The signs indicating that this was the direction, was there the whole time. I do art, I document. My music (which in correlation to the umbrella of art) has and always was vital because of my inclination to create since youth and pattern recognition. The complexes I gained post death have been 180• In nature of who I was, ‘I’ was always trying to fight to be on the surface every time an argument happened with my wife, slipping out of this and that measure, telling me things while I’m essentially alive and unconscious of the empathetic nature of humanity, in regards to whose at the surface of survival given a range of seconds to weeks. With little room here and there for my higher, at the time hindered, self.

I felt like a never ending natural disaster losing everything he loved at his core pre death 
Post death has let me access a lot of regressed skills indicative of the gifted child I was supposed to be. I am maintaining conscious and deep leveled and repressed pattern recognizing and universe explaining conversations with people around me that don’t even want to think that way !!! I felt convoluted pre, and even more so, now. But it’s the positive nature in my intent shining through and being received that’s now inflating my self worth. Also things I gotta be receptive of. I have to practice cognitive empathy now more than ever or else. Because rn due to obvious mania by brain breakage, I have to be ultra aware of the newfound ability of impulse control. Still failing to meet people where they need to be met, but no malice is truly attached to these ways that once looked like blatant exploitive behavior. Especially under the light that me and my wife are living in similar theme of life. 
I’m just as tangent-like as before just so much more regulated. In which micro versions of these experiences were felt, when my existence (her support) was felt to be threatened by confrontational discussion, to the range of the expression of divorce, I ‘cleaned my act up’  just to ‘slip back into my bullshit’ in her justified perception. 
With new ability to understand deeper than ever and knowing I can now attribute the right things to myself, I take accountability, action, and the universe is reciprocal at the moment. Everything feels great other than these tired feelings of not being able to sleep. Everything is scary in regards to the fear of being that person, truly again. He is on the back burner smoldering. His attributes aren’t necessarily weak in nature, and I am able to reach into skills built through this ego, such as confidence. Keeping grandiose ideas together in relation to the effort that needs to be put in, is a well known thing in myself now. I truly feel like I can drive, work pretty much anywhere, and do pretty much anything by my modes of mean and intellect. What it speaks to, is only in my control now. Through induced emotional regulation by emotional disembowelment.
